name: Lightning Form
description: The creature can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the creature or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage. In addition, the creature can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage and must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn or it takes damage.
